additional_info.body:
Hi Tom ,
I hope this email finds you well.
Checking the charger I could see that it also affect the outlet 2 sometimes and I could check this session that ended at
Feb 18,2026,13:58:51 PM.
On this session the charger was able to delivery energy but the car was not asking any voltage with 100% on the battery.
The same happen with the outlet 1, most of them work as normal and I also found this one that failed because of internet.
On the screenshot shared you can see the charger had the information from the car on "green", and ready on "orange" but no PLC link due to Network Unreachable.
Following these last checks the reason was the car or also the internet.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical
Support Team – Felipe Moraes
